# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-18 from the 2026-10-18 Hub dump.

- 3,161,429 models tracked, 897,225 declare a base model, 930,179 parent links, 88,174 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
